requirement: The portal accepts a payment webhook only when the gateway's signature over its body verifies.
The portal marks a booking paid only when the webhook's amount and booking match an open charge.
Patient sign-in allows at most 10 failed attempts per account per hour.
Sign-up and password changes refuse passwords found in known breach lists.
Staff sign-in requires a second factor every time.
A staff account unused for 30 days is disabled automatically.
The portal's storage credential can create exam files and cannot overwrite or delete them.
Every change to a clinical note is kept as a new version with its author and time.
Every cancellation records the account that made it and when.
The portal returns an exam only to the patient it belongs to and answers any other request as if it did not exist.
A reminder text contains only the date and time and how to cancel.
The receptionist role cannot open clinical notes or exams.
An upload larger than 20 MB or not a PDF is refused.
An account triggers at most 5 reminder messages a day.
The staff console answers only requests from the clinics' network.
The reminder worker's database account can read bookings and nothing else.
Patients see their open sessions and can end any of them.
Signing in from a new device or changing the phone number sends the patient an e-mail.
Changing the phone number needs a code sent to the old number.
